# attestation-issuer

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-issuer.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `attestation-issuer` component of `servlets/attestation-issuer`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.attestation`: generated from its catalogue, [attestation-issuer.json](../../servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-issuer.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_ATTESTER_`, `OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_`, `OIDF_WALLET_`, `OIDF_ENTRA_`, `OIDF_CIMD_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `challengeRequired` (init-param) | `false` | Whether an instance-key proof must carry a challenge from /federation/attestation/challenge; the issuance servlet enforces it and the two discovery servlets advertise it, each from its own init-param, so set the three alike | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false; servlets that disagree advertise one thing and enforce another | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_REQUIRED` (init-param `customClaimsRequired`, then system property `oidf.attestation.custom.claims.required`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_REQUIRED`) | Unset; a list | Claims every instance-key proof must carry besides the protocol's, comma-separated: enforced by the issuance servlet and advertised as custom_claims_required; the init-param customClaimsRequired on each of those two servlets wins over the system property and the environment | **Per request**: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces and refuses a list of nothing, which this reader does not); a claim a client does not send refuses its every issuance | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_SUPPORTED` (init-param `customClaimsSupported`, then system property `oidf.attestation.custom.claims.supported`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_SUPPORTED`) | Unset; a list | Claims the client attestation service document advertises as custom_claims_supported, comma-separated; advertised only; the init-param customClaimsSupported on the metadata servlet wins over the system property and the environment | **Not checked**: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces and refuses a list of nothing, which this reader does not); nothing enforces it | Any | No |
| `challengeEndpointEnabled` (init-param) | `true` | Whether the client attestation service document advertises challenge_endpoint; on the metadata servlet | **Not checked**: Set to anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | No |
| `attestationSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `RS256,PS256,ES256`; a list | The algorithms the client attestation service document advertises as attestation_signing_alg_values_supported, comma-separated; on the metadata servlet, advertised only | **Not checked**: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces); blank, or a list of nothing such as ", ,", is the default, and nothing checks it against the keys attestations are signed with | Any | No |
| `openBaoUrl` (init-param) | Unset | OpenBao's address for attestation signing keys (a client's attestation_signing_key_ref), on the issuance servlet; used only with openBaoToken, and with either unset both come from OIDF_OPENBAO_URL and OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN and their fallbacks (hosted-entity-signing) | **Per request**: Wrong or unreachable: a client whose attestation_signing_key_ref needs the vault is refused with server_error | Any | Yes |
| `openBaoToken` (init-param) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The OpenBao token for the same, on the issuance servlet; used only with openBaoUrl | **Per request**: Refused by OpenBao: as for openBaoUrl | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_FEDERATION_ENTITY` (system property `oidf.attester.federation.entity`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_FEDERATION_ENTITY`) | Unset; an http or https URL | An OpenID Federation entity whose signed statement maps SPIFFE IDs to clients, consulted before the CIMD document and PingFederate's client store, and trusted only through a chain to a pinned trust anchor (OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHOR_JWKS); an entity the anchor stops vouching for loses its clients within 300 s | **First request**: Named with no trust anchor pinned: the attester refuses to build its client sources at its first request | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_SIGNING_JWK` (system property `oidf.attester.signing.jwk`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_SIGNING_JWK`) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The attester's private signing key as an inline JWK, applied to every client the federation entity or the CIMD document describes; never read from those documents | **Per request**: Missing or malformed: those clients are refused (invalid_client) at issuance, unless an entry names a signing_key_ref | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_CIMD_URL` (system property `oidf.attester.cimd.url`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_CIMD_URL`) | Unset; an http or https URL | A Client ID Metadata Document as a client source, honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development (plan item M-1, F-0067): the document hands the attester every client's bindings and trust roots, so whoever answers at the URL chooses the keys the attester accepts | **First request**: Set outside development: at the attester's first request the cimd source is left out with an ERROR naming the variable, and the other sources keep serving | Not in production | Yes |
| `OIDF_CIMD_TRUST_BUNDLES` (system property `oidf.cimd.trust.bundles`, then env `OIDF_CIMD_TRUST_BUNDLES`) | Unset | Only whether it is set counts: set, with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, the client attestation service document lists cimd in client_metadata_sources_supported; nothing reads its value or enforces it | **Not checked**: Its value is never read | Any | No |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_OP_ISSUER` (system property `oidf.attester.op.issuer`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_OP_ISSUER`) | Unset | The hosted attester's own entity id, the relying party in a wallet provider's trust chain; with a trust controller configured (OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST) it turns on federation-backed wallet provider trust, in preference to OIDF_WALLET_PROVIDER_JWKS | **Per request**: Wrong: no wallet provider's chain resolves, and every wallet instance attestation is refused | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_WALLET_PROVIDER_JWKS` (system property `oidf.wallet.provider.jwks`, then env `OIDF_WALLET_PROVIDER_JWKS`) | Unset; a JSON object | Wallet providers trusted statically, a JSON object of provider entity id to its JWK Set, used only when federation-backed wallet trust is not configured; the keys are trusted with no trust chain | **Not checked**: Not a JSON object: ignored without a word, and every wallet instance attestation refused; an entry that is not a JWK Set is skipped | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ENTRA_AGENT_DIRECTORY` (system property `oidf.entra.agent.directory`, then env `OIDF_ENTRA_AGENT_DIRECTORY`) | Unset; a JSON object | The Entra Agent ID directory, a JSON object of asserted oid to directory entry, which registers the entra-directory asserted-context resolver; its ceiling only narrows an evidenced one | **Not checked**: Unparseable: no resolver is registered, without a word | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_SPIRE_ENTRIES_URL` (system property `oidf.attester.spire.entries.url`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_SPIRE_ENTRIES_URL`) | Unset; an http or https URL | A SPIRE entries endpoint whose selectors are added to an instance's workload attributes at issuance; unset, no introspection | **Not checked**: Unreachable: the instance gets no selectors | Any | Yes |
